Pre-stable beta release for Sane Next.

What changed since v0.3.0-beta.1:

- Added GitHub Actions release packaging for Linux, macOS, and Windows archives.
- Added `cli/package_release.sh` for building release archives with the CLI binary and README.
- Fixed the release workflow so CI uploads only `.tar.gz` and `.zip` archives, not build directories.
- Kept CI on the full matrix: Go unit tests and Pi plugin tests on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows, plus Ubuntu acceptance.
- Fixed Windows Codex export validation so POSIX-style absolute paths are rejected on Windows.
- Tightened CLI acceptance coverage around install, doctor, export, repair, update, and uninstall behavior.
- Updated README install instructions for the `0.3.0-beta.2` release archive names.
- Rewrote repo and skill instructions to use positive routing and workflow steps instead of long negative-rule lists.
- Added instruction-surface guidance for writing future AGENTS and skill prompts.
- Refreshed project docs and tracking text to match the current GitHub Releases distribution path.

Download the archive for your OS/CPU, extract it, and run the included `sane-next` command from the extracted directory.
